d:
Dilli se lahaur tak, zahrili dhundh har sal aam logon ke lie ek ganbhir svasthy sankat ban jati hai. iski vajah se logon ki rozmarra ki zindgi prabhavit hoti hai aur lakhon logon ko aisi pradushit hava men sans lene ke lie majbur hona parta hai, jo unki sehat ke lie khatra hai.
Lekin sajha samadhan talashne ke bajay bharat aur pakistan aksar ek-dusre par vayu pradushan barhane ka aarop lagate rahe hain.
